notes.title: Major Update: [New Coin Pusher] + [Anime-Style Poster Girl] Now Available!
notes.content:
Apologies for keeping everyone waiting! Thank you all  for your love and support of "Coin Push RPG"![p align="justify"]These two major updates are thanks to your active feedback.
[p align="justify"]Here's a summary of the main new content:
[p align="justify"]1. \[New Coin Pusher Machine] We've decided to release this for FREE! Hope you all enjoy it!
[p align="justify"]2. \[Anime-style Assistant Girl DLC] This is a paid DLC, launchingwith an additional 10% discount! Get an super cute assistant girl for a single-digit price! (Includes 8 interactive actions like head pat, happy, and over 15 lines of Japanese and Chinese voice acting.)
[p align="justify"]Detailed Update Content
[p align="justify"]1. Added the \[Super Lucky Star] New Coin Pusher Machine - Free Update!
[p align="justify"]Players just need to update the base game to experience it!
[p align="justify"]Ps: The "big" coin tower you've all been asking for is here!
[p align="justify"]Rules Explanation:
[p align="justify"]① The turntable spins continuously. When a token lands in a UFO, you receive the reward corresponding to the UFO's color at the current pointer position.
[p align="justify"]② The number and winning color pointed to will light up on the corresponding level of the lighthouse on the left. After a level lights up, you receive the reward.
[p align="justify"]③ When you earn a Lucky Star, the transport chute accumulates one layer of tokens. After accumulating 50 layers, they are instantly generated onto the playfield.
[p align="justify"]④ When the Golden Ball is hit, the turntable starts a lottery draw. If the ball falls into a hole, you get the corresponding reward. (Includes a playfield clearance reward.)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106032/c67be6fe915891076a09baee2d9c64592f50dade.gif"]


[p align="justify"]2. Released \[Coin Push RPG - Ruri] DLC
[p align="justify"](This DLC is a "Supporter Pack" for Coin Push RPG. The content is an Assistant Girl skin-type DLC. It contains no numerical values or anything that affects gameplay experience.)
[p align="justify"]DLC Content: Includes 8 interactive actions for the assistant girl (head pat, happy, etc.), and over 15 lines of Japanese and Chinese voice acting.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106032/918a616dcdfef1b55a090f64fc85a00ca9d63e72.gif"]


[p align="justify"]Introduction:
[p align="justify"]Name: Ruri / 神宮寺 琉璃
[p align="justify"]Gender: Female
[p align="justify"]Height: 165cm
[p align="justify"]Age: 18 (First year at a top private university / Newly elected Student Council President)
[p align="justify"]Background:
[p align="justify"]The sole heir to the Shinguuji conglomerate. Raised with an elite education from childhood, she lives in opulent conditions beyond most people's imagination. Her every move exudes the elegance and grace of a young lady from a prestigious family, recognized in social circles as the "perfect ojō-sama" (young lady). Her academic results consistently top the charts. With impeccable ability and a dignified yet approachable demeanor, she served as student council president in high school and was quickly elected again upon entering a top-tier university. She excels at strategy, coordination, and public speaking, earning the trust of teachers and the admiration of her peers.
[p align="justify"]However, this perfect young lady harbors a huge secret unknown to most—she is utterly obsessed with arcade coin pusher machines! It all started with a rare act of "rebellion" in her childhood when she sneaked into an arcade. She was completely captivated by the dazzling lights of a coin pusher, the clattering sound of coins, and the instant thrill. Since then, beyond high-end salons and private concerts, shabby or trendy arcades have become her "sanctuary" for releasing stress and seeking pure joy.
[p align="justify"]Personality:
[p align="justify"]In Public: The flawless student council president image. Confident, calm, rational, dignified with just the right amount of elegance and reserve. Her speech and conduct are impeccable. She handles affairs decisively and possesses strong leadership skills and a sense of responsibility. She holds herself to extremely high standards, with a slight tendency towards perfectionism and tsundere traits.
[p align="justify"]In Private (Arcade Mode): Once she enters the arcade, it's like a seal has been lifted! Her gaze becomes sharp and focused, her lips curl into an unconscious smile, and she might even show childlike excitement and tension ("Ah! So close! One more coin!").
[p align="justify"]In front of the coin pusher, she's no longer the lofty ojō-sama but a passionate player immersed in the game. She will clench her fist and whisper in triumph for a perfect push, or stomp her foot in frustration at a near miss (though she quickly returns to calm analysis

notes.title: 20K Sales in 24 Hours! Free Skin DLC & Fast Push Mode Announced!
notes.content:
Dear Coin Heroes:

We have exciting news to share—our game Coin Push Brave has sold over 20,000 copies on its first day!
Thank you all for your love and support! We will continue optimizing the game and adding new content.

We sincerely apologize for the numerous issues in the initial release (e.g., unsatisfying coin-pushing mechanics, coins being swallowed at the sides), which affected many players' experiences.
Thank you for your passionate feedback! We will actively prioritize fixes and improvements based on your input. Your voices are crucial to making Coin Push Brave better and better!

To show our gratitude, here’s our short-term development roadmap:

1. Priority: "Fast Push Mode"
Many players have noted that the current coin-pushing mechanics feel too rigid. We will swiftly launch a "Fast Push Mode" that removes the side coin slots and increases win rates.

2. Free Skin DLC
To thank our players, we will release a free skin DLC after the Fast Push Mode update!

3. New Coin-Pusher Styles DLC
Beyond the current designs, we plan to add new coin-pusher templates with fresh mechanics, including popular modes like "Coin Tower" and "30-Second Frenzy."

4. New Brave Backgrounds
Responding to feedback about limited background options, we will release 2 new Brave backgrounds soon to enable more diverse builds.

These updates will roll out gradually over 1-3 months. As a small indie team (just 3 people!), we ask for your patience and understanding. Thank you again!

Finally, we want to emphasize that our game thrives on your passion and feedback. We’re listening closely and acting on every suggestion.

May Coin Push Brave bring you endless joy!
Official Discord: https://discord.com/invite/R6dETkSBp7

notes.title: 《Coin Push RPG》 launches on May 23rd!!!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!
Today, we’re thrilled to announce some long-awaited news!

《Coin Push RPG》 will officially launch on May 23rd, Beijing Time!

Over the past few months, we’ve not only expanded the content but also carefully reviewed and implemented hundreds of your suggestions. 
From improving the shine of the coin pusher to refining the texture of coin towers, adding more gameplay mechanics, and expanding build diversity—we’ve put in the work to make sure your wait is worth it!


Tired of having to go to an arcade to enjoy coin pushers? Or maybe traditional coin pushers just don’t excite you anymore? Then it’s time to try Coin Pusher RPG!


Brand-New Challenge Mode  : A Fresh Experience Every Time!

In the full version, we’re introducing an all-new Challenge Mode, unlocked after clearing Chapter 4 for endless fun!
At the start, you’ll get to pull the lever for buffs—but beware! Every buff you claim for yourself also powers up the BOSS!
High rewards come with high risks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106032/cdb363d770a8864bac8c57f8fff61d37ded51dde.gif

Pure Coin Pusher Gameplay

The full version will feature a new Mode, where you can enjoy classic, no-frills coin-pushing action! Faithfully recreating the arcade experience, this mode delivers the authentic thrill you know and love.
Stack  up, spin the wheel, or go for the full-board jackpot—it’s all here in Pure Coin Pusher Mode!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106032/0fefe00b17328a1d98035c22d4d3a900ce5913ae.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106032/81de295bf399eee982f8e6b9c5d861d8637fe323.gif

Idle Progression System

In Adventure and Endless Mode, you’ll experience our deep idle progression mechanics. 
Compared to the demo, the full game offers double the content!
Dozens of new talents, a red-tier hero system, a red talent tree, and new equipment slots have been added to enrich your strategy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106032/09e5439f56c89e7f8a708b958d064bf491f9d34b.png

Get ready for a massive and content-packed experience .
        The full version offers over twice the content of the demo! And that’s not all！
        Stay tuned for even more surprises in the official release of Coin Push RPG!

        Finally, to all the fans who love Coin Push RPG, we want to say: "Thank you for your love, support, and companionship. We’ll keep moving forward and improving the game!"

If you’re excited for Coin Push RPG, don’t forget to wishlist it to get notified the moment it launches! Also, join our Discord community:   https://discord.gg/RBb4exFu   for the latest updates and exclusive sneak peeks!


See you on May 23rd!

This new product festival version brings a plethora of content updates 👇

Additions:
1.Added "Experience Book" item, which can increase hero experience in strongholds.
2.Introduced two new character backgrounds: Shadow Swift Clan and Vanguard Tiger Tribe.
3.Added gacha exchange in the shop.
4.Included a new prize, "Water Column," in the lucky draw.
5.Implemented a renaming feature for heroes.
6.Added layout switching in the hero list, allowing to toggle between list and grid views.
7.Added position numbers on avatars in the expedition and battle interfaces.
8.Included initial background tips in the archive.
9.Unlocked the endless mode.

Optimizations:
1.Adjusted the visual effect of "Strate Mice" stealing coins.
2.Expanded the coin area of the coin pusher to increase the capacity for coins.
3.Appropriately adjusted the prices for equipment enhancement and refining.
4.Changed hero leveling to automatic to reduce manual operations.
5.Added gold consumption to some heroes' opening skills.
6.Adjusted the traits and talents of the character background "Sea Caller."
7.Modified some localization texts.
8.Enlarged the font size of character attribute panels and adjusted the UI.
9.Increased the drawing speed of the lottery machine.
10.Upgraded the ticket display of the ticket dispenser to show four digits.
11.Added sound effects and special effects when leveling up characters in strongholds.
12.Adjusted the unlock levels for some features.
13.Modified the layout of the village and added a small icon to building titles.
14.Adjusted the new player guidance process, adding descriptions and highlight frames.
15.Optimized the store purchase logic, enabling right-click to buy equipment and automatically switching to the next item after purchase.
16.Performance optimization, reducing CPU/GPU usage during background idling.

Bug Fixes:
1.Fixed some crash issues.
2.Resolved the issue where the lottery speed decreased while idling in the background.
3.Fixed some problems with buff stack accumulation.
4.Addressed the issue where the new player guide could not be completed smoothly at certain resolutions.
5.Removed incorrect weapon types from the blacksmith's filter list.
6.Fixed the error where the结算 panel displayed a combo of 999.
7.Resolved the discrepancy between resolution switching and the actual resolution under specific conditions.
8.Fixed the issue where repurchasing a single material showed a quantity of 0.

Finally, thanks for everyone trying out the game!
